# Security Analysis

Run comprehensive security analysis using the ATLAS threat detection framework.

## Capabilities
- Static code analysis for vulnerabilities
- Binary/PE malware detection
- MITRE ATT&CK mapping
- CVE scanning
- Dependency audit

## Usage
- `/security` — analyze the active file
- `/security src/auth.rs` — analyze a specific file
- `/security --folder src/` — scan entire folder
